direction_alignment: Metal009 maps have parallel horizontal brush marks (U axis); a constant axial tangent replaces circular cell orientation.
identity_statement: Machining data originates from authored brushed STEEL Metal009; the game material independently authors ALUMINUM reflectance. This is a reusable surface-finish recipe, not a scanned linear-brushed aluminum asset or proof of physical equivalence between alloys.

BaseColor.modifications: None; existing upstream source file referenced without copying or alteration

Direction.decode: theta=.5*atan2(2*G-1,2*R-1); theta is axial, modulo pi
Direction.modifications: Analytical constant field only; no invented machining grain or source alteration
Direction.packing: RGB=(255,128,255): R=(1+cos(2theta))/2, G=(1+sin(2theta))/2, B=confidence1; ideal theta=0 radians, horizontal U-axis brushing
Direction.quantization_note: RGB8 cannot encode .5 exactly; G128 gives decoded angle about .1123 degrees. This is the requested constant encoding, not spatial variation.

Normal.normal_convention: DirectX tangent space; do not flip green
